question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the supported public plugin-SDK contract for transient tool progress?
rationale: The patch adds permanent third-party-facing API surface; functional review can assess its mechanics but cannot authorize the long-term plugin contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
options.body: Keep the marker and predicate as the canonical producer-to-channel progress contract after structured Slack delivery is fixed.

options.title: Keep progress typing internal
options.body: Replace the public exports with a narrower internal or plugin-owned handoff before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the marker and predicate as the canonical producer-to-channel progress contract after structured Slack delivery is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the affected Slack native-block, plugin SDK, and Codex boundaries.
